tags.name: Users
tags.description: User management, pagination, sorting, and query endpoints

post.summary: Authenticate with Zalo OA authorization code
Refresh access token using refresh token
User login with username/email and password

get.summary: Get paginated, sorted, and filtered list of users

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size (number of items per page)

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Keyword to search across username, email, or fullName

AuthResponse.description: Authentication token response containing access and refresh tokens

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token for obtaining new access tokens
Opaque refresh token issued at login
Refresh token to revoke upon logout

PageResponseUserResponse.description: Standardized pagination and sorting response wrapper

content.description: List of items in the current page

size.description: Page size (number of items requested per page)

totalElements.description: Total number of elements matching the query

first.description: Whether this is the first page

last.description: Whether this is the last page

hasNext.description: Whether there is a next page available

hasPrevious.description: Whether there is a previous page available
